decisions.rationale: Intended Mega: Charizard Y. Raichu+Primarina deny the immediate Sand Rush Excadrill turn with Fake Out while Primarina threatens it directly and retains strong sand matchups. Garchomp supplies Rock Slide and Ground pressure into Blaziken/Excadrill, while Charizard Y is a late weather overwrite and SolarBeam answer to Hippowdon once sand control is disrupted.

Intended Mega: none — Blaziken benched, no Mega Stone in this four. Lead Whimsicott+Hippowdon: t1 job is Prankster Taunt on Venusaur (priority beats 264-speed Chlorophyll, kills Sleep Powder/Protect) while Hippo sets sand and Yawns Zard (Rock Slide can't OHKO: 48-90%) or Ice Fangs Chomp. Hippo re-entry flips Drought back to sand. Back two: Excadrill is the 280-speed sand sweeper (LO Rock Slide OHKOs Zard, HH OHKOs Raichu, Electric-immune); Gyarados answers Garchomp (EQ-immune, Intimidate, Ice Fa
decisions.notebook: Series: I lead 1-0 (g1 WON via sand core). Opponent = Drought sun stack: Zard-Y + Chlorophyll Venusaur (Focus Sash, Modest), Raichu (Fake Out/Lightning Rod/Nuzzle, Sitrus, Timid), Garchomp (Yache, Rough Skin, Jolly), Primarina (Expert Belt), Goodra-H (Leftovers, Shell Armor). g1 four: Zard/Venu/Raichu/Chomp; Sleep Powder never used — expect g2 adjustment = Venusaur lead to sleep Excadrill, or Primarina/Goodra-H brought. CONFIRMED DAMAGE: sand LO Rock Slide OHKOs Mega Zard through spread; HH OHKOs Raichu and KOs Venusaur (sash); Hippo Rock Slide only 48-90% to Zard (no OHKO — Yawn instead); Hippo Ice Fang ~63% to Chomp; Gyarados Ice Fang 2HKOs Chomp (Yache eats hit 1); Excadrill Iron Head likely OHKOs Primarina, HH 2HKOs Goodra-H; Hydro Pump OHKOs Blaziken. KEY MECHANICS: Zard mega Drought triggers after lead Sand Stream → sun t1; Hippowdon re-entry flips to sand (also wins simultaneous re-entry, slower). Sand Excadrill = 280, outruns roster incl. sun Chlorophyll Venu (264 max). Raichu cannot hurt Excadrill except Fake Out (Electric-immune) — never trade for it; opponent Protects Raichu and spams EQ. Excadrill at ~80% is inside Jolly Chomp spread-EQ range — Protect/pivot to Gyarados. Mega Blaziken wasted vs this matchup (EQ-weak, TPunch Lightning Rod-redirected) — benched. G2 TEAM: Hippowdon/Excadrill/Gyarados/Whimsicott, no Mega. Lead Whimsicott+Hippo: Taunt shuts sleep/Protect, Yawn Zard, Ice Fang Chomp; Whimsicott 184 outspeeds all but sun-Venu (Taunt priority covers), Encore locks setup/Protect, Moonblast 2x SE Chomp. If no Zard lead, sand stays t1 — get Excadrill in ear

decisions.rationale: Fake Out always moves before Prankster Tailwind and denies Whimsicott’s support. Hydro Pump is a guaranteed OHKO on Hippowdon if it connects, removing Sand Stream and the key Excadrill enabler immediately. Hippowdon Protect is the main punish, but still leaves Whimsicott flinched and unable to establish Tailwind.

Both my mons sit in possible-OHKO range (Hydro Pump->Hippo, Ice Beam->Whimsicott) and Whimsicott lacks Protect. Hippo Protects; Whimsicott pivots to Excadrill, which takes Ice Beam neutrally (19.8-55.7%, never OHKO) and is immune to Raichu's Electric moves/Fake Out flinch next turn since Fake Out is burned. Excadrill at 280 Spe in sand outruns their roster; t2 Iron Head threatens Primarina OHKO while Hippo spams Rock Slide/Yawn, sand chipping both foes.

decisions.rationale: Protect denies Life Orb High Horsepower while Hydro Pump threatens a guaranteed OHKO on Hippowdon if it does not land its reduced-success Protect. Targeting Hippowdon punishes Excadrill Protect, whereas targeting Excadrill can lose momentum to its full-success Protect plus Yawn. Primarina should survive a single Rock Slide to fire back.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s sand mode is Hippowdon plus Life Orb Sand Rush Excadrill. Hippowdon carries Rock Slide, Ice Fang, Yawn, and Protect; its Ice Fang is a major Garchomp check. Gyarados with Wacan Berry may be a late-game win condition. Opponent brought Mega Blaziken in Game 1; Whimsicott and Gengar were not brought then. Prioritize Excadrill control while retaining an answer to Gyarados; avoid committing sun into intact sand mode.

decisions.rationale: Tool check overturns my notebook: Iron Head only does 51-98% of max to Primarina (KO only vs min bulk), while Hydro Pump guaranteed OHKOs Excadrill. Not worth the coin flip. Raichu is harmless (Electric-immune duo, Fake Out spent). Excadrill Protects; Hippo Yawns Primarina's slot — if it stays it sleeps end of t3 (free Iron Head KO), if it switches the switch-in gets drowsy. Hippo comfortably tanks any Primarina hit. Sand keeps chipping.

decisions.rationale: Whimsicott is the safe pivot: resists both foes' STABs, only Ice Beam chips it, and its Prankster Encore/Taunt disrupts Protect-stall while 280-speed Excadrill OHKOs Primarina with HH next turn (Raichu cannot touch Excadrill). decisions.rationale: Primarina cannot survive Life Orb Iron Head, so Protect is mandatory. Nuzzle is the best available Whimsicott control: Tailwind still goes first through Prankster, but paralysis can limit its subsequent speed and action reliability. Preserve Primarina to Hydro Pump Excadrill after this turn.

decisions.rationale: Excadrill (280) outruns everything and HH OHKOs Primarina; the only out is Protect or a switch. Prankster Taunt lands first and blocks Protect, so Primarina dies before moving (its Hydro Pump would OHKO Excadrill). Raichu is Electric-immune-locked out of hurting Excadrill and is ignored. A switch-in still eats heavy neutral/SE damage and Taunt.

decisions.rationale: Primarina is vulnerable to Excadrill moving first, while a repeated Protect is unreliable. Switching it to Ground-immune Garchomp denies High Horsepower; Raichu Protect avoids Rock Slide or a read into its slot. This preserves Primarina for Excadrill/Gyarados and waits out sand pressure.

Excadrill 280 outruns everything and HH OHKOs Primarina (verified); only a 1/3 Protect or Ground-immune Zard switch saves it, and Taunt can't beat +4 priority Protect regardless. Raichu cannot hurt Excadrill and Whimsicott resists its moves, so Whimsicott is free: Tailwind now guarantees Excadrill (280) and Gyarados (266) outrun Garchomp/Mega-Zard/Chlorophyll-Venu once sand ends or Drought flips it, and Rock Slide then answers a Zard switch-in (4x weak).

decisions.rationale: Garchomp cannot act before Sand Rush Excadrill and must Protect. Primarina preserves Raichu’s late Gyarados answer while immediately threatening Excadrill with Hydro Pump after sand ends. Do not expose Charizard to Life Orb Rock Slide. This accepts Rock Slide accuracy but covers High Horsepower and creates the strongest follow-up pressure.

Excadrill at 280 outspeeds everything; HH KOs 24% Garchomp before it can EQ, and Raichu cannot hurt Excadrill at all. If Garchomp Protects or switches to Charizard, the HH is a small loss and Tailwind still goes up, keeping Excadrill at 280 after sand ends so Rock Slide (4x vs Zard) and HH (OHKO Primarina) stay ahead of the sun mode. Tailwind beats Encore here because post-sand speed control is the endgame; only full para (25%) denies it.

decisions.rationale: Garchomp is exposed to Excadrill and Whimsicott, while its consecutive Protect is unreliable and vulnerable to Encore. Preserve it by bringing Raichu in; Hydro Pump forces Excadrill to respect a guaranteed KO if it does not Protect. Raichu gives next-turn Fake Out/Nuzzle control after Tailwind expires.

Charizard is the only meaningful fresh attacker and can Mega Evolve next turn to threaten Excadrill with sun-boosted Heat Wave. Garchomp is already too low to rely on and offers little beside a temporary High Horsepower immunity. Raichu has no legal action while Primarina is replaced.

Excadrill (280) outruns everything and HH OHKOs Primarina before Hydro Pump can fire; Whimsicott (184) outruns max-Speed Garchomp (169) and 2x-SE Moonblast KOs it at 24%. Only full para or successful Protects save them, and failed Protects just lower their odds for the identical repeat next turn. A Charizard pivot is answered by Rock Slide next turn.

decisions.rationale: Mega Heat Wave in sun guarantees KOs on both active foes if it connects. Fake Out denies Excadrill’s immediate Rock Slide, the only listed super-effective attack into Charizard, and prevents its Protect-less offensive line. Whimsicott cannot stop Heat Wave with its listed moves; Tailwind is already active and Moonblast is resisted.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s sand mode is Hippowdon plus Life Orb Sand Rush Excadrill. Hippowdon carries Rock Slide, Ice Fang, Yawn, Protect. Whimsicott has Prankster Tailwind, Encore, Taunt, Moonblast and Mental Herb; it was successfully paralyzed. Excadrill has shown Protect and repeated High Horsepower. Opponent brought Mega Blaziken in Game 1; preserve an answer to Wacan Berry Gyarados. Mega Charizard Y sun Heat Wave is a strong simultaneous answer to Excadrill and Whimsicott when their Protect/Fake Out interactions are managed.

decisions.rationale: Raichu re-entered t6, so Fake Out is live at +3 priority and outspeeds Encore; a flinch into Mega-Y sun Heat Wave guaranteed-double-KOs my board (verified). Protect + Gyarados switch blocks every line: Fake Out wasted, Heat Wave resisted 0.5x, Thunderbolt 4x halved by Wacan, Air Slash neutral. Turn 8 with Tailwind still up: Excadrill (280) Rock Slide (96-180% on Zard, 31.7-65.9% on 46% Raichu) plus Gyarados Waterfall backup on Zard, then HH/Ice Fang/Moonblast finish 24% Garchomp. Whimsicott stay

If Raichu falls or Gyarados Protects, Tailwind expires and Charizard outspeeds both foes, retaining sun-boosted Heat Wave for Excadrill and Solar Beam for Gyarados.
Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Excadrill (280) outruns Zard and Rock Slide deals 96-180% even spread; burned Waterfall adds ~18-34%, so Zard dies on any hit (90%). Spread Rock Slide also KOs 46% Raichu. Fake Out can't re-arm (Raichu out since t6). If Zard Protects, RS full-power KOs Raichu; if Raichu pivots to 24% Garchomp, RS likely KOs it too. Only RS miss is catastrophic, but every alternative lets Heat Wave connect into Excadrill.

decisions.rationale: Both attackers move before the foes. Solar Beam cleanly removes Gyarados unless it Protects, while Earthquake threatens the weakened Excadrill and Charizard is immune. This covers either single Protect; only a double Protect fully denies the double-KO line. Avoid Rock Slide and Heat Wave accuracy/spread compromises.

Post-Tailwind, Timid Zard (up to 167) and Jolly Chomp (up to 169) likely outrun Excadrill 140, and sun Heat Wave KOs it from 50% — attacking is a speed gamble. Protect guarantees Excadrill lives through the likely Heat Wave + EQ (EQ can't touch Gyarados). Burned Ice Fang vs 24% Chomp does ~44-52 through Yache, KOing almost always; even a low roll leaves it at chip range. Next turn 2v1 vs Zard: LO Rock Slide (96-180%) + Waterfall (18-34%) always KOs, and its Protect chain is degraded.

Endgame plan: 2v1 vs Zard = Rock Slide + Waterfall; Whimsicott Encore can lock a Protect or resisted move; Air Slash is 2x SE on Whimsicott — keep it out of Zard's way. Blaziken benched.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Heat Wave acts before Excadrill and is the only move that can immediately remove both remaining foes. In sun it is super-effective into each and has guaranteed KOs if it connects; Excadrill's reduced-success Protect is the main denial line. Air Slash only targets one foe and leaves Excadrill free to Rock Slide.

Charizard is the opponent's last mon. Whimsicott's Prankster Tailwind moves at +1 priority regardless of paralysis, doubling Excadrill to 280 Spe (above Zard's 167 max); tool-verified solo-target LO Rock Slide is a guaranteed OHKO (128.6-241.2%). If Zard Protects, Tailwind persists and we repeat with its Protect odds halved. Only fail modes: 25% full-para on Tailwind or a 10% Rock Slide miss into Heat Wave.
decisions.notebook: Series: p2 leads 1-0. Opp = sun stack: Zard-Y + Chlorophyll Venu (Sash, Modest), Raichu (Fake Out/LightningRod, Sitrus, Timid), Garchomp (Yache, RoughSkin, Jolly), Primarina (ExpertBelt, Modest), Goodra-H (Leftovers, ShellArmor). TOOL-VERIFIED: Excadrill HH OHKOs Primarina & Raichu, KOs Venu through sash; Primarina Hydro Pump OHKOs Excadrill — never let it act vs Excadrill; LO Rock Slide vs Mega Zard = guaranteed OHKO when solo target (128-241%), 96-180% as spread; Gyarados burned Ice Fang vs low-HP Chomp ~44-52 through Yache; HH 2HKOs Goodra-H. Zard-Y sun Heat Wave KOs Excadrill from 60% and Whimsicott from 84% — never let it connect. Raichu Fake Out only on entry turn; re-arms on re-entry. Tailwind Excadrill 280 outruns all incl. sun Venu (264). Slower setter wins simultaneous weather; Zard mega Drought flips sand. Outside Tailwind/sand, Timid Zard (up to 167) and Jolly Chomp (up to 169) likely outrun Excadrill 140 — never rely on Excadrill outspeeding; use Protect+chip or Tailwind. Opp tendencies: Protects Raichu repeatedly, pivots to dodge HH, spams EQ/Heat Wave, double-pivots around Garchomp Protect. G2 team Hippo/Excadrill/Gyarados/Whimsicott, no Mega; Blaziken benched. G2: opp reduced to last mon Zard-Y; Whimsicott paralyzed but Prankster Tailwind still +1 prio; finisher = Tailwind + Rock Slide, repeat through Protects.

reflections.summary: Lost because the Charizard Y/Raichu/Garchomp/Primarina four was strained by the opponent’s Excadrill-Gyarados speed and Rock/Ice coverage: Primarina and Raichu fell before the endgame, Garchomp was removed by Ice Fang, and Charizard could not survive Excadrill’s Rock Slide once Tailwind was available.
reflections.adjustment: Rework the game-3 bring to avoid making Charizard Y the primary Excadrill endgame answer; preserve Raichu or another speed-control route to stop/paralyze Whimsicott and keep a sturdier answer to Life Orb Excadrill plus Gyarados.
reflections.notebook: Opponent’s sand mode is Hippowdon plus Life Orb Sand Rush Excadrill. Hippowdon carries Rock Slide, Ice Fang, Yawn, Protect. Excadrill has Rock Slide, Iron Head, High Horsepower, Protect, and frequently uses Protect to deny Fake Out or attacks. Whimsicott has Prankster Tailwind, Encore, Taunt, Moonblast and Mental Herb; it was successfully paralyzed and can reset Tailwind late. Gyarados is Intimidate with Wacan Berry, Waterfall, Ice Fang, Dragon Dance, Protect. Opponent brought Mega Blaziken in Game 1. Future plan: preserve a Whimsicott speed-control answer and do not rely on Mega Charizard Y to close against a live Excadrill with Rock Slide.

reflections.summary: Won (series 2-0) because the no-Mega sand+Tailwind plan fully neutralized the sun stack: Excadrill removed Primarina before it could Hydro Pump, Gyarados traded burn-chip to finish low-HP Garchomp with Ice Fang, and the pre-verified finisher — Prankster Tailwind (still +1 through paralysis) plus LO Rock Slide — OHKO'd Mega Zard-Y as its last mon. Zero decision errors; team-preview call to bench Blaziken and bring Hippo/Excadrill/Gyarados/Whimsicott was correct.
reflections.adjustment: Keep the same four and no-Mega plan. Minor piloting tweak: don't let Gyarados eat the Mega-turn Heat Wave burn — double-Protect or pivot Whimsicott in on the obvious Zard-Y Mega + Fake Out turn so Gyarados keeps full Ice Fang/Waterfall damage for Garchomp instead of trading at half power.
